title:
Vertex in an {@link Data.Flow} which represents an action that returns a {@link Data} or {@link Data.Series}.
This vertex will not have any parents and is used for a minimal representation of Data.Flow used for execution. Only
produced when {@link DataToFlowSpec#useCachedData} is true.
